rows.solvedProblem: DONE closeout snapshot is persisted through the DONE merge and cleanup boundary.
rows.acceptance: After a real DONE transition, canonical story metadata contains milestone-closeout.json and the story worktree can be removed without losing it.
evidence: CHK-001:happy:0 [pass/logic_test] npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs file=packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs note=Build passed and milestone-status regression passed. The new B-done-closeout-worktree fixture creates a real git worktree, advances DONE, removes the story worktree, then reads proofbound.milestone_closeout.v1 from canonical main.

CHK-001:adversarial:0 [pass/logic_test] node packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs file=packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs note=The worktree fixture asserts the story worktree no longer exists before canonical main Store and CLI milestone_closeout read the snapshot, so a transient worktree-only file cannot satisfy the test; existing missing-ledger cases also still pass.

rows.solvedProblem: Regression coverage proves canonical-root milestone_closeout succeeds after DONE cleanup.
rows.acceptance: The focused test fails if closeout is only written in the worktree or deleted during cleanup, and passes only when canonical root can read proofbound.milestone_closeout.v1.
evidence: CHK-002:happy:0 [pass/logic_test] node packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs file=packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs note=The regression runs a full enough DONE path through createStoryAdvanceHandlers from a linked story worktree and verifies canonical-root milestone_closeout returns proofbound.milestone_closeout.v1 after cleanup.

CHK-002:edge:0 [pass/logic_test] node packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs file=packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs note=The regression distinguishes canonical-root persistence from worktree-local writes by instantiating a new StoryStore at mainRoot after worktree deletion and reading milestone-closeout.json there.

CHK-002:adversarial:0 [pass/logic_test] node packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs file=packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs note=If DONE cleanup deletes the only closeout copy or fails to merge it into canonical metadata, the mainRoot Store/CLI assertions in the regression fail.
